title: Project Contract
description: Start with the README and package manifest to understand Pushgate as a git pre-push gate with deterministic checks and provider-backed local AI review.

title: CLI And Hook Entry
description: Follow the installed hook and CLI dispatcher into the pre-push workflow that decides whether a push proceeds.

title: Configuration Loading
description: Review how v2 configuration is loaded, normalized, validated, and surfaced through the public config facade.

title: Changed File Policy
description: Trace target branch resolution, git diff parsing, path filtering, and public path-policy composition.

title: Deterministic Gate
description: Inspect how built-in policy checks and configured tool commands are evaluated before local AI review runs.

title: Process Execution Boundary
description: Look at the new process helpers that centralize command execution, timeout handling, inherited stdio, and output capture.

title: Provider Commands
description: Follow the local AI provider boundary through registry selection, provider configuration, Claude/Copilot adapters, and shared command execution.

title: Review Context And Verdict
description: Study how Pushgate builds review context, renders prompts, applies guardrails, parses output, writes transcripts, and turns provider results into push verdicts.

title: Distribution And Templates
description: Connect the build scripts, generated runner, starter templates, and distribution docs that package Pushgate for installation.

title: Tests And Refactor Plans
description: Use the tests and staged refactor docs to see how the new module boundaries are verified and where the next deepening steps are planned.
